title: Long-form Video-to-Text Summarization using Recursive Language Models

problem.summary: While VideoLLMs have made significant progress in understanding short video benchmarks, they often struggle to summarize long-form ones.
statements: While VideoLLMs have made significant progress in understanding short video benchmarks, they often struggle to summarize long-form ones.
This is mainly due to performance degradation caused by long-context prompts, the inherent difficulty of preserving temporal continuity and a lack of semantically rich concepts in event descriptions.
To tackle these issues, this paper introduces the first recursive Video Language Summarization Model (RVLSM) designed for video processing and tailored to long-form video-to-text summarization.
